source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 9ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Ναρσής και Αρτέμωνας»

attestations.note: The life page says of him «Ο Ναρσής ήταν Πέρσης και ίσως να είναι ο ίδιος με αυτόν της 9ης Δεκεμβρίου» — he was a Persian and may perhaps be the same as the one of 9 December. That doubt is the page's own and is left as it stands: this folder records the 9 Νοεμβρίου entry, which is the day page read, and proposes nothing about the December one. The page gives no year, so there is no `dates` object. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (1 October 2026).
